hardGateFindings.finding: Hiring-reader comprehension, collaborator agreement, application results, production approval, deployment, and hiring effectiveness remain explicitly unmeasured. The reader study, solicitation, and job-search follow-through are planned, and no repository receipt is presented as a completed external outcome.

All eight blind spots map one-for-one to controls with a signal, owner, trigger, decision rule, evidence-return path, and next test. The checker derives current graph counts, full-population inquiry coverage, exact role and public-proof sets, concrete route claim inventories, and current surface and mosaic digests. Node 26 independently reproduced the required bundle digest.

The protocol distinguishes deterministic validation, separate read-only LLM judge sessions, and external human evidence. It requires distinct session provenance and hashed artifacts, prohibits the generator from judging, and states that repository provenance is auditable process evidence rather than cryptographic proof. Prior judge scores were not used as evidence.

Canonical-to-public projection removes protected locators and nonpublic sources, while citation, path-containment, public-safety, and route checks passed. The current mosaic review covers relationship, movement, affiliation, platform-custody, feedback, educational-record, and raft-crew aggregation risks, records minimizations, and disclaims legal, participant, and collaborator approval.

limitations: This is an independent LLM repository judgment, not human reader research, collaborator or participant review, legal or privacy advice, production approval, deployment verification, application evidence, or hiring validation.

Protected source contents, including the Kansas City Star scan and private collaborator context, were not independently available; this review assessed their public-safe metadata, evidence relationships, boundaries, projection state, and deterministic controls.

The reader study, hiring-reader solicitation, and outward job-search follow-through remain planned with no returned external receipts. External effectiveness is therefore not-yet-measured, and actionability is scored 4 rather than 5.

The full blind-spot checker reports only stale current-run bundle and judge references. Per the judging instruction, those artifacts are the known cycle being replaced and were not treated as candidate-control defects.

Role classifications, mosaic decisions, and hill-climb history remain repository-authored governance judgments. Their structure and exact-set coverage are machine-observable, but their semantic truth and independence are not established merely by repository receipts.
